To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthArc: SOC2 + pen test walkthrough — booking request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We’re gearing up for a SOC 2 readiness review and a coordinated pen test with our vendor RedTeam Labs. Can we lock in a 60–75 minute walkthrough to cover: SOC 2 controls scope, DPA nuances for token handling, and high-level pen-test boundaries?

Attendees likely: myself (security lead), James Li (appsec), and our procurement partner. We’re flexible next week but prefer US morning slots (9–11am PT). If there’s a short pre-call checklist or an evidence map you can share ahead of time that would be super helpful.

Also looping in our procurement alias procure@northarc.com for contractual questions.

Thanks,
Danielle Park
Security Lead | NorthArc Financial
security@northarc.com

Attachments: SOC2-scope-summary.pdf (summary of expected scope)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <dani@northarc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthArc: SOC2 + pen test walkthrough — booking request

Hi Danielle — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful.

We can do a 75-minute joint session that covers SOC 2 mapping, DPA implications, and a pen-test scoping brief. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 11 May, 9:30–10:45am
- Wed 12 May, 10:00–11:15am
- Thu 13 May, 9:00–10:15am

Could you confirm who will own evidence transfer (SFTP/Drive) and whether RedTeam will join the call? If procurement needs to review contract redlines beforehand, we can include Ben from our legal/procurement coordination.

Quick ask: I’ll send an evidence map template and a short prep checklist now — can your team fill the high-level controls column and return it before the call? That will make the session much more actionable.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
